stances.summary: Questions tight labor market claims despite job growth
stances.quote:
Employers seems able to hire all the workers that they want, so is this a tight labor market? 
Long-term unemployment is still rising, job growth has been concentrated in just a few industries. 
And yet, wow, +172K is impressive. And the 3-month average is even more impressive.
